device_id.description: Syncthing device ID (13 uppercase hex characters). Auto-generated on first run; set to empty to auto-generate.

device_name.description: Human-readable name for this Syncthing instance (e.g., 'Laptop-1', 'Server-NYC')

compression.description: Compression level for sync traffic: 'off', 'metadata', or 'always'

listen_addresses.description: List of addresses to listen on for incoming connections (e.g., ['tcp://:22000', 'tcp://[::]:22000', 'dynamic']).

announce_global_enabled.description: Enable global announcement servers (used to find public devices via the STUN/relays).

announce_local_enabled.description: Enable local network announcement (mDNS/LAN) to discover other Syncthing devices on the same network.

upnp_enabled.description: Enable automatic UPnP/NAT-PMP port mapping for outbound connections.

addresses_for_self.description: Optional explicit addresses to announce for this device (e.g., ['tcp://mypublichost:22000']). Leave empty to auto-detect.

folders.description: List of folders to synchronize. Each defines a path, devices, and optional settings.

id.description: Unique ID for the folder (auto-generated if empty, e.g., 'default-1').

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the folder.

device_id.description: Device ID of the peer to sync with. Use empty string for self (optional for multi-device folders).

rescan_interval_s.description: Rescan interval in seconds for local changes.

fs_watcher_enabled.description: Enable filesystem change watchers for instant sync detection (may be unreliable on some filesystems).

fs_watcher_delay_s.description: Delay after last change before syncing (in seconds) to coalesce rapid changes.

ignore_perms.description: Ignore permission changes when detecting changes (helpful for cross-OS sync).

ignored_paths.description: List of paths (relative to folder) to ignore (e.g., ['.git', 'node_modules/**']).

versioning.description: File versioning settings (e.g., for simple versions, trashcan).

cleanup_interval_s.description: Interval to clean up old versions (seconds).

max_age_s.description: Maximum age of versions before deletion (0 = unlimited).

versions_path.description: Custom path to store versions (relative or absolute).

keep_versions.description: Number of versions to keep per file (for 'trashcan' and 'staggered').

gui_address.description: Address and port to bind the GUI to (e.g., '0.0.0.0:8384', '192.168.1.10:8384').

gui_tls_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS for the GUI (requires manual TLS cert/key config in real deployments; here just sets mode).

gui_user.description: Username for GUI authentication. Leave blank for no auth (NOT recommended for production).

gui_password.description: Password (BCrypt-hashed) for GUI authentication. Generate via 'syncthing --generate' or CLI.

gui_api_key.description: API key for external API access (e.g., for monitoring tools). Leave empty to disable.

metrics_enabled.description: Enable metrics collection for external reporting (e.g., Prometheus).

metrics_db_path.description: Path to SQLite database for metrics storage (only used if metrics enabled).

mdns_enabled.description: mDNS discovery configuration. One or more entries (currently one standard block supported).

enabled.description: Enable mDNS discovery on local network.

relays.description: List of public Syncthing relay servers to use for NAT traversal.

global_upload_rate_kib.description: Global upload rate limit in KiB/s (0 = unlimited).

global_download_rate_kib.description: Global download rate limit in KiB/s (0 = unlimited).

max_recv_kbps.description: Per-device receive rate limit in KiB/s (0 = unlimited).

max_send_kbps.description: Per-device send rate limit in KiB/s (0 = unlimited).

auto_accept_folders.description: Automatically accept new folders from newly introduced devices (security risk).

min_home_disk_free.description: Minimum free disk space required on the Syncthing data directory (e.g., '1%', '100MB').

min_home_disk_free_unit.description: Unit of 'min_home_disk_free': 'percent' or 'bytes' (used in template for validation context only).

reconnect_interval_s.description: Interval to retry connection to disconnected devices (seconds).

allow_initial_peers_connection.description: Allow connections to peers listed in config before full discovery completes.
